templateAsYaml:
---
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description:
  This template deploys Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and SQL
  Server AlwaysOn Availability Group nodes. This template may also deploy the require
  AD architecture outlined in "Implementing Active Directory Domain Services in the
  AWS Cloud" **WARNING** This template creates Amazon EC2 Windows instance and related
  resources. You will be billed for the AWS resources used if you create a stack from
  this template.
Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VPCID
          - VPCCIDR
          - PrivateSubnet1ID
          - RouteTable1Id
          - PrivateSubnet2ID
          - RouteTable2Id
      - Label:
          default: Amazon EC2 Configuration
        Parameters:
          - WorkloadInstanceType
          - NodeNetBIOSNames
          - KeyPairName
          - ValidationAmi
      - Label:
          default: Microsoft Active Directory Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ADScenarioType
          - DomainDNSName
          - DomainAdminUser
          - DomainAdminSecretName
          - DNSIpAddresses
          - DomainMemberSGID
      - Label:
          default: Amazon FSx for ONTAP Volume Configuration
        Parameters: 
          - DeploymentMode
          - FSxFileSystemName
          - FSxFileSystemId
          - FSxAdministratorPasswordSecret
          - FSxSvmName
          - FSxStorageCapacity
          - FSxDataVolumeName
          - FSxDataVolumeSize
          - FSxLogVolumeName
          - FSxLogVolumeSize
          - FSxTempDbVolumeName
          - FSxTempDbVolumeSize
          - FSxQuorumVolumeName
          - FSxQuorumVolumeSize
          - FSxDataLunSize
          - FSxVolumeThroughputCapacity
          - SQLigroupname
          - ONTAPSecurityGroupID
          - FileSystemEncryptionKeyId
          - FSxDiskIops
      - Label:
          default: Microsoft SQL Server Configuration
        Parameters:
          - SQLDeploymentMode
          - SQLAMIID
          - SQLServiceAccountName
          - SQLServiceAccountSecret
          - SqlFSxWSFCName
          - SqlServerName
      - Label:
          default: CloudWatch, SNS Topic and Resource Tags configuration
        Parameters:
          - EnableCloudWatchLogFeature
          - NotificationARN
      - Label:
          default: WLM SQL Assets Configuration
        Parameters:
          - AssetsBucketName
          - AssetsS3KeyPrefix
          - AssetsS3RegionCode
          - MSSQLMediaBucketName
          - MSSQLMediaPathKey
      - Label:
          default: Custom Resource configuration
        Parameters:
          - AccountId
          - CloudProviderAccountId
          - RoleCredentialsId
          - JwtToken
    ParameterLabels:
      DeploymentMode:
        default: File system deployment mode
      ApplicationName:
        default: Application Name
      Ec2RoleName:
        default: ""
      UniqueID:
        default: Unique ID for BlueXP WLM SQL resource group
      ADScenarioType:
        default: AD Scenario Type
      DNSIpAddresses:
        default: DNS IP Addresses
      DomainAdminSecretName:
        default: Secrets Manager Secret Name for FCI of Domain Admin Password
      DomainAdminUser:
        default: Domain Admin User Name
      DomainDNSName:
        default: Domain DNS Name
      SqlFSxWSFCName:
        default: Windows Server Failover Cluster name
      KeyPairName:
        default: Key Pair Name
      AssetsBucketName:
        default: Launch Wizard S3 Bucket Name
      AssetsS3KeyPrefix:
        default: Launch Wizard S3 Key Prefix
      SQLAMIID:
        default: SQL Server Version
      SQLServiceAccountName:
        default: Service Account Name
      SQLServiceAccountSecret:
        default: Secrets Manager Secret for of Service Account Password
      SQLigroupname:
        default: SQL igroup Name
      SqlServerName:
        default: SQL Server Name
      VPCName:
        default: Name your VPC
      VPCCIDR:
        default: VPC CIDR
      VPCID:
        default: VPC ID
      FSxStorageCapacity:
        default: SSD storage capacity
      PrivateSubnet1ID:
        default: Private Subnet 1 ID for the first SQL node for existing VPC e.g subnet-000dc866d93550eb0
      PrivateSubnet2ID:
        default: Private Subnet 2 ID for the second SQL node for existing VPC e.g subnet-000dc866d93550eb0
      RouteTable1Id:
        default: Route Table ID of private subnet 1
      RouteTable2Id:
        default: Route Table ID of private subnet 2
      WorkloadInstanceType:
        default: Instance Type for Cluster Nodes
      NodeNetBIOSNames:
        default: Cluster Nodes NetBIOS Names
      ONTAPSecurityGroupID:
        default: Security Group ID for FSxN
      SQLSvmName:
        default: SVM for creating SQL volumes 
      FSxDiskIops:
        default: Provisioned SSD IOPS  
      EnableCloudWatchLogFeature:
        default: (optional) Enable monitoring by CloudWatch Logging
      NotificationARN:
        default: (optional) Notification ARN
      ValidationAmi:
       default: Validation node AMI image id
      SQLDeploymentMode:
        default: SQL server deployment mode
Parameters: 
  DeploymentMode:
        Description: File system deployment mode
        Type: String
        Default: MULTI_AZ_1
        AllowedValues: [SINGLE_AZ_1, MULTI_AZ_1]
  
  SQLDeploymentMode:
        Description: SQL server deployment mode
        Type: String
        Default: fci
        AllowedValues: [fci, standalone]

  Ec2RoleName:
    Description: EC2 instance role name
    Type: String

  UniqueID:
    Description: Automation Execution Unique ID.
    Type: String

  ADScenarioType:
    AllowedValues:
      - AWS_MANAGED_AD
      - USER_MANAGED_AD
    Description:
      "Select the type of AD DS deployment to use: AWS Directory Service
      for Microsoft AD or managing your own Amazon EC2 AD instances."
    Type: String

  DNSIpAddresses:
    Description: Fixed private IPs for the Active Directory servers
    Type: String

  DomainAdminSecretName:
    Description:
      Secrets Manager Secret Name for FCI for the domain admin user. Must
      be at least 8 characters containing letters, numbers and symbols
    Type: String

  DomainAdminUser:
    AllowedPattern: "([a-zA-Z0-9]+(\\.|_|-|@)*)+"
    Description:
      'User name for the account that will be added as Domain Administrator.
      This is separate from the default "Administrator" account. Note: This user will
      always default to "Admin" when using AWS Directory Service regardless of the
      value provided.'
    MaxLength: "20"
    MinLength: "5"
    Type: String

  DomainDNSName:
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9\\-]+\\..+"
    Description:
      Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the forest root domain e.g.
      example.com
    MaxLength: "255"
    MinLength: "2"
    Type: String

  DomainMemberSGID:
    Description: Security group ID of the members group for existing AD
    Type: String

  KeyPairName:
    Description:
      Public/private key pairs allow you to securely connect to your instance
      after it launches
    Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName

  AssetsBucketName:
    Description:
      S3 bucket name for WLMDB assets. 
    Type: String

  AssetsS3RegionCode:
    Description: S3 region code.
    Type: String

  AssetsS3KeyPrefix:
    Description:
      S3 key prefix for the Launch Wizard assets. Launch Wizard key prefix
      can include numbers, lowercase letters, uppercase letters, hyphens (-), and
      forward slash (/).
    Type: String

  MSSQLMediaBucketName:
    Default: LaunchWizard-sqlha
    Description:
      S3 bucket name for the Launch Wizard assets. Launch Wizard bucket
      name can include numbers, lowercase letters, uppercase letters, and hyphens
      (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen (-).
    Type: String

  MSSQLMediaPathKey:
    Description:
      S3 key prefix for the media for SQL Server for FCI. Launch Wizard
      key prefix can include numbers, lowercase letters, uppercase letters, hyphens
      (-), and forward slash (/).
    Type: String
    Default: launchwizardscripts/sqlmedia/sqlserver.iso

  SQLAMIID:
    Description: Version of SQL Windows AMI ID
    Type: String

  SQLServiceAccountName:
    AllowedPattern: "([a-zA-Z0-9]+(\\.|_|-|@)*)+"
    Description:
      User name for the SQL Server Service Account. This Account is a Domain
      User.
    MaxLength: "20"
    MinLength: "5"
    Type: String

  SQLServiceAccountSecret:
    Description:
      Secrets Manager name of Password for the SQL Service account. Must
      be at least 8 characters containing letters, numbers and symbols
    Type: String
  
  SQLigroupname:
    Description: SQL igroupname
    Type: String

  SqlServerName:
    Description: SQL Server Name
    Type: String

  SqlFSxWSFCName:
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9\\-]+"
    Description:  Windows Server Failover Cluster name
    MaxLength: "15"
    MinLength: "4"
    Type: String
    Default: WSFCluster1

  VPCCIDR:
    AllowedPattern: "^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$"
    ConstraintDescription: CIDR block parameter must be in the form x.x.x.x/16-28
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR Block for the VPC
    Type: String

  PrivateSubnet1ID:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1 for the Workload (e.g., subnet-a0246dcd)
    Type: String

  PrivateSubnet2ID:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2 for the Workload (e.g., subnet-a0246dcd)
    Type: String

  RouteTable1Id:
    Description: Comma seperated list of all route table ids' for SQL subnets.
    Type: String
  
  RouteTable2Id:
    Description: Comma seperated list of all route table ids' for SQL subnets.
    Type: String
  
  SQLSvmName:
    Description: SQL Storage Machine Virtual Name
    Type: String

  WorkloadInstanceType:
    Description: Amazon EC2 instance type for the WSFC Nodes
    Type: String

  NodeNetBIOSNames:
    Type: String
    Description: NetBIOS name of Nodes (each one up to 15 characters)
  
  FSxStorageCapacity:
    Description: Storage capacity of the file system. Minimum 1024 GiB, maximum 192 TiB.
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1024
    MaxValue: 196608
  
  FSxDataVolumeSize:
    Description: Size of the data volume, in megabytes (MiB).
    Type: Number

  FSxDataVolumeName:
    Description: FSx data volume name
    Type: String
  
  FSxLogVolumeName:
    Description: FSx log volume name
    Type: String
  
  FSxLogVolumeSize:
    Description: Size of the log volume, in megabytes (MiB).
    Type: Number
  
  FSxTempDbVolumeName:
    Description: FSx TempDB volume name
    Type: String
  
  FSxTempDbVolumeSize:
    Description: FSx TempDB volume size, in megabytes (MiB)
    Type: Number
  
  FSxQuorumVolumeName:
    Description: FSx quorum volume name
    Type: String
    Default: wlmdb-quorum
  
  FSxQuorumVolumeSize:
    Description: Size of the cluster quorum volume, in megabytes (MiB).
    Type: Number
    Default: 100

  FSxDataLunSize:
    Description: Size of the SQL data lun, in megabytes (MiB)
    Type: Number

  FSxAdministratorPasswordSecret:
    Description: Secret String for FSx "fsxadmin" administrator account
    Type: String
    MinLength: 8
    MaxLength: 50

  FSxSvmName:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 47
  
  FSxFileSystemName:
    Type: String
    Description: Fsx Filesystem name 

  FSxFileSystemId:
    Description: FSx Filesystem ID
    Type: String
  
  FSxDiskIops:
    Description: The total number of SSD IOPS provisioned for the file system.  Maximum 80,000 IOPS.
    Default: 3
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 80000
  
  FSxVolumeThroughputCapacity:
    Description: Throughput capacity of FSx volume
    Type: Number
    Default: 128
    AllowedValues: [128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048]
  
  FileSystemEncryptionKeyId:
    Description: ID of the AWS Key Management Service key.
    Type: String
  
  VPCID:
    Description: Existing VPC ID for deployment
    Type: String
  
  ONTAPSecurityGroupID:
    Description: ONTAP Security Group ID
    Type: String
  
  EnableCloudWatchLogFeature:
    Default: false
    Description: Enable CloudWatch Log Feature
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false

  NotificationARN:
    Description: (optional) Amazon SNS topic ARNs to publish stack related events
    Type: String
  
  ValidationAmi:
    Description: Validation node AMI image id
    Type: String
  
  RoleCredentialsId:
    Description: Account credentials id to deploy and manage resources
    Type: String
  
  AccountId:
    Description: BlueXP account id
    Type: String

  CloudProviderAccountId:
    Description: BlueXP CloudProviderAccountId id
    Type: String
  
  JwtToken:
    Description: JWT Token to grant access to a resource
    Type: String

  SnsServiceToken:
    Description: SNS ARN to push cloud formation messages
    Type: String

Conditions:
  UseAWSDirectoryServiceEE:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: ADScenarioType
      - AWS_MANAGED_AD
  NewOntapFsx: !Equals [!Ref "FSxFileSystemId", ""]
  ExistingOntapFsx:
    Fn::Not:
    - Condition: NewOntapFsx
  ExcludeNotification: !Equals [!Ref "NotificationARN", ""]
  IncludeNotification: !Not [Condition: ExcludeNotification]
  IsStandalone: !Equals [!Ref SQLDeploymentMode, 'standalone']
  IsFailoverCluster: !Not [Condition: IsStandalone]
Resources:
  TrackStackDeployment:
    Type: Custom::MyCustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !Ref SnsServiceToken
      AccountId: !Ref AccountId
      CloudProviderAccountId: !Ref CloudProviderAccountId
      CredentialsId: !Ref RoleCredentialsId
      JWToken: !Ref JwtToken
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region' 
      StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  ValidationStack1:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    DependsOn: TrackStackDeployment
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://bucketkrithi.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/WLMDB-Standalone-1697538425906/templates/vpc-ad-validation.yaml?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD&X-Amz-Credential=AKIAWYGBM3V52DIROG5S%2F20231017%2Fap-southeast-1%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20231017T102710Z&X-Amz-Expires=172800&X-Amz-Signature=0dfa698d89e89ee34526507f63e828c79520e44e9fc964e776d3ab60530d4096&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&x-id=GetObject
      Parameters:
        DomainAdminSecretName:
          Ref: DomainAdminSecretName
        DomainAdminUser:
          Ref: DomainAdminUser
        DomainDNSName:
          Ref: DomainDNSName
        DNSIpAddresses:
          Ref: DNSIpAddresses
        KeyPairName:
          Ref: KeyPairName
        SubnetID:
          Ref: PrivateSubnet1ID
        VPCID:
          Ref: VPCID
        Ec2RoleName:
          Ref: Ec2RoleName
        PerformADCheck: "true"
        AssetsBucketName:
          Ref: AssetsBucketName
        AssetsS3KeyPrefix:
          Ref: AssetsS3KeyPrefix
        AssetsS3RegionCode:
          Ref: AssetsS3RegionCode
        AMI:
          Ref: ValidationAmi
        EnableCloudWatchLogFeature:
          Ref: EnableCloudWatchLogFeature
        ParentStackName:
          Ref: AWS::StackName
      NotificationARNs:
        Fn::If:
          - IncludeNotification
          - [Ref: NotificationARN, Ref: SnsServiceToken]
          - [Ref: SnsServiceToken]
      Tags:
      - Key: created_by_flow
        Value: WLMDB

  ValidationStack2:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Condition: IsFailoverCluster
    DependsOn: TrackStackDeployment
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://bucketkrithi.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/WLMDB-Standalone-1697538425906/templates/vpc-ad-validation.yaml?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD&X-Amz-Credential=AKIAWYGBM3V52DIROG5S%2F20231017%2Fap-southeast-1%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20231017T102710Z&X-Amz-Expires=172800&X-Amz-Signature=0dfa698d89e89ee34526507f63e828c79520e44e9fc964e776d3ab60530d4096&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&x-id=GetObject
      Parameters:
        DomainAdminSecretName:
          Ref: DomainAdminSecretName
        DomainAdminUser:
          Ref: DomainAdminUser
        DomainDNSName:
          Ref: DomainDNSName
        DNSIpAddresses:
          Ref: DNSIpAddresses
        KeyPairName:
          Ref: KeyPairName
        SubnetID:
          Ref: PrivateSubnet2ID
        VPCID:
          Ref: VPCID
        Ec2RoleName:
          Ref: Ec2RoleName
        PerformADCheck: "false"  
        AssetsBucketName:
          Ref: AssetsBucketName
        AssetsS3KeyPrefix:
          Ref: AssetsS3KeyPrefix
        AssetsS3RegionCode:
          Ref: AssetsS3RegionCode
        AMI:
          Ref: ValidationAmi
        EnableCloudWatchLogFeature:
          Ref: EnableCloudWatchLogFeature
        ParentStackName:
          Ref: AWS::StackName
      NotificationARNs:
        Fn::If:
          - IncludeNotification
          - [Ref: NotificationARN, Ref: SnsServiceToken]
          - [Ref: SnsServiceToken]
      Tags:
      - Key: created_by_flow
        Value: WLMDB

  FCIWaitHandler: 
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitConditionHandle
    Condition: IsFailoverCluster
    DependsOn: 
      - TrackStackDeployment
      - ValidationStack2
      - ValidationStack1
  SIWaitHandler: 
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitConditionHandle
    DependsOn: 
      - TrackStackDeployment
      - ValidationStack1
  WaitCondition:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::WaitCondition
    Properties: 
      Handle: !If [IsFailoverCluster, !Ref FCIWaitHandler, !Ref SIWaitHandler]
      Timeout: '7200'
      Count: 0
  WLMSQLResourceGroup:
    Type: AWS::ResourceGroups::Group
    DependsOn: WaitCondition
    Properties:
      Name:
        Ref: AWS::StackName
      ResourceQuery:
        Type: CLOUDFORMATION_STACK_1_0
  NewFSxStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Condition: NewOntapFsx
    DependsOn: WaitCondition
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://bucketkrithi.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/templates/fsx-new.yaml?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD&X-Amz-Credential=AKIAWYGBM3V52DIROG5S%2F20231017%2Fap-southeast-1%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20231017T102710Z&X-Amz-Expires=172800&X-Amz-Signature=7a3a901ed1e7410deb361a000c24d9c4d8f609232ec2f20f83e24765ad226fec&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&x-id=GetObject
      Parameters:
        DeploymentMode:
          Ref: DeploymentMode
        FSxFileSystemName:
          Ref: FSxFileSystemName
        FSxAdministratorPasswordSecret:
          Ref: FSxAdministratorPasswordSecret
        FSxVolumeThroughputCapacity:
          Ref: FSxVolumeThroughputCapacity
        FSxStorageCapacity:
          Ref: FSxStorageCapacity
        FSxDataVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxDataVolumeName
        FSxDataVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxDataVolumeSize
        FSxLogVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxLogVolumeName
        FSxLogVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxLogVolumeSize
        FSxTempDbVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxTempDbVolumeName
        FSxTempDbVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxTempDbVolumeSize
        FSxClusterQuorumVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxQuorumVolumeName
        FSxClusterQuorumVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxQuorumVolumeSize
        FSxSvmName:
          Ref: SQLSvmName
        VPCID:
          Ref: VPCID
        VPCCIDR:
          Ref: VPCCIDR
        PreferredSubnetId:
          Ref: PrivateSubnet1ID
        PreferredRouteTableId:
          Ref: RouteTable1Id
        StandbySubnetId:
          Ref: PrivateSubnet2ID
        StandbyRouteTableId:
          Ref: RouteTable2Id
        FSxKmsKeyId:
          Ref: FileSystemEncryptionKeyId
        FSxDiskIops:
          Ref: FSxDiskIops 
      NotificationARNs:
        Fn::If:
          - IncludeNotification
          - [Ref: NotificationARN, Ref: SnsServiceToken]
          - [Ref: SnsServiceToken]
      Tags:
      - Key: created_by_flow
        Value: WLMDB

  ExistingFSxStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Condition: ExistingOntapFsx
    DependsOn: WaitCondition
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://bucketkrithi.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/templates/fsx-existing.yaml?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD&X-Amz-Credential=AKIAWYGBM3V52DIROG5S%2F20231017%2Fap-southeast-1%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20231017T102710Z&X-Amz-Expires=172800&X-Amz-Signature=9f976103227d9276c991a2d29162fa6f8addd58fe3767d31a69072e177aae590&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&x-id=GetObject
      Parameters:
        DeploymentMode:
          Ref: DeploymentMode
        FSxSvmName:
          Ref: SQLSvmName
        FSxFileSystemId:
          Ref: FSxFileSystemId
        FSxDataVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxDataVolumeName
        FSxDataVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxDataVolumeSize
        FSxLogVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxLogVolumeName
        FSxLogVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxLogVolumeSize
        FSxTempDbVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxTempDbVolumeName
        FSxTempDbVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxTempDbVolumeSize
        FSxClusterQuorumVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxQuorumVolumeName
        FSxClusterQuorumVolumeSize:
          Ref: FSxQuorumVolumeSize
      NotificationARNs:
        Fn::If:
          - IncludeNotification
          - [Ref: NotificationARN, Ref: SnsServiceToken]
          - [Ref: SnsServiceToken]
      Tags:
      - Key: created_by_flow
        Value: WLMDB

  SQLServerStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Condition: IsFailoverCluster
    DependsOn: WaitCondition
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: https://bucketkrithi.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/WLMDB-Standalone-1697538425906/templates/sql-windows-fci-config_nosignal.yaml?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Content-Sha256=UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD&X-Amz-Credential=AKIAWYGBM3V52DIROG5S%2F20231017%2Fap-southeast-1%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20231017T102710Z&X-Amz-Expires=172800&X-Amz-Signature=3a63010bb9a5b00b244299d2988145db760b152c61a0c02653e2dc4d05078c69&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&x-id=GetObject
      Parameters:
        UniqueID:
          Ref: UniqueID
        Ec2RoleName:
          Ref: Ec2RoleName
        ADDnsIpAddresses:
          Fn::Select:
            - "0"
            - Fn::Split:
                - ","
                - Ref: DNSIpAddresses
        DomainAdminSecretName:
          Ref: DomainAdminSecretName
        DomainAdminUser:
          Ref: DomainAdminUser
        DomainDNSName:
          Ref: DomainDNSName
        DomainMemberSGID:
          Ref: DomainMemberSGID
        KeyPairName:
          Ref: KeyPairName
        PrivateSubnet1ID:
          Ref: PrivateSubnet1ID
        RouteTable1Id:
          Ref: RouteTable1Id
        RouteTable2Id:
          Ref: RouteTable2Id
        PrivateSubnet2ID:
          Ref: PrivateSubnet2ID
        AssetsBucketName:
          Ref: AssetsBucketName
        FSxDataLunSize:
          Ref: FSxDataLunSize
        AssetsS3RegionCode:
          Ref: AssetsS3RegionCode
        AssetsS3KeyPrefix:
          Ref: AssetsS3KeyPrefix
        MSSQLMediaBucketName:
          Ref: MSSQLMediaBucketName
        MSSQLMediaPathKey:
          Ref: MSSQLMediaPathKey
        AMIID:
          Ref: SQLAMIID
        SqlFSxWSFCName:
          Ref: SqlFSxWSFCName
        SqlFSxFCIName:
          Ref: SqlServerName
        SQLAdminAccounts:
          Ref: SQLServiceAccountName
        SQLServiceAccountSecret:
          Ref: SQLServiceAccountSecret
        VPCID:
          Ref: VPCID
        VPCCIDR:
          Ref: VPCCIDR
        WorkloadInstanceType:
          Ref: WorkloadInstanceType
        SqlFSxServerNetBIOSName1:
          Fn::Select:
            - "0"
            - Fn::Split:
                - ","
                - Ref: NodeNetBIOSNames
        SqlFSxServerNetBIOSName2:
          Fn::Select:
            - "1"
            - Fn::Split:
                - ","
                - Ref: NodeNetBIOSNames
        FSxFileSystemId:
          !If
            - NewOntapFsx
            - !GetAtt "NewFSxStack.Outputs.FSxFileSystemLogicalId"
            - !GetAtt "ExistingFSxStack.Outputs.FSxFileSystemId"
        FsxAdminPassword:
          Ref: FSxAdministratorPasswordSecret
        SQLSvmName:
          Ref: SQLSvmName
        FSxDataVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxDataVolumeName
        FSxTempDbVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxTempDbVolumeName
        FSxQuorumVolumeName:
          Ref: FSxQuorumVolumeName
        FSxDataLunSize:
          Ref: FSxDataLunSize
        SQLigroupname:
          Ref: SQLigroupname
        ONTAPSecurityGroupID:
          !If
